Question: Does your app contain ads?
Notes: No ad SDKs (no AdMob); Meta/GA4/PostHog are measurement only, not ad-serving.

Question: Is any part of your app restricted?
Notes: Google Sign-In required to use the app; premium subscription tiers gate apply/share/set.

Question: Reviewer instructions
Notes: Google Sign-In only (no username/password) - reviewer uses any Google account. Browsing/preview is free; premium (subscription) only unlocks apply/save/set, so the core experience is fully reviewable without purchase.

Question: Does the app natively allow users to interact or exchange content with other users (voice/text/images/audio)?
Notes: No user-to-user messaging/sharing. User-submitted wallpapers go to a moderation queue to become app content, not to other users.

Question: [If Yes] Is shared user-generated content the primary source of content?
Notes: Catalog is curated/published by the studio; user submissions are optional and moderated.

Question: [If Yes] Does the app permit public sharing of nudity?
Notes: All submissions are moderated before publishing.

Question: [If Yes] Does the app permit public sharing of real-world graphic violence outside newsworthy context?
Notes: All submissions are moderated before publishing.

Question: [If Yes] Does the app include the ability to block users or user-generated content?
Notes: Submissions are reviewed and can be rejected/removed by moderators before they ever appear.

Question: Does the app feature/promote content not part of the initial download but accessible from the app?
Notes: Wallpapers and ringtones are streamed from the CDN/catalog at runtime and grow over time via the CMS - not bundled in the APK/AAB.

Question: Does the app share the user's current and precise physical location with other users?
Notes: App does not access or share location.

Question: Does the app allow users to purchase digital goods?
Notes: Premium subscription (PhonePe UPI AutoPay).

Question: Does the app include cash rewards, gift cards, play-to-earn, crypto rewards, or transferable digital assets (NFTs)?
Notes: None of these features exist.

Question: Is the app a web browser or search engine?
Notes: It is a wallpaper/ringtone app.

Question: What are the target age groups of your app?
Notes: Requires sign-in and paid subscriptions; no under-18 audience or families policy safeguards built.

Question: Does your app collect or share any of the required user data types?
Notes: Collects account info, app activity, device/other IDs incl. advertising ID.

Question: Is all user data collected by your app encrypted in transit?
Notes: All traffic over HTTPS/TLS to the Worker API and third-party SDKs.

Question: Which methods of account creation does your app support?
Notes: Google Sign-In (OAuth); no username/password. Not "no account" - signing in creates an account.

Question: Do you provide a way for users to request that their account and data be deleted?
Notes: In-app: Settings -> Delete account (instant, self-serve). Email fallback: support@hsrutility.com.

Question: Delete account URL
Notes: Public page documenting in-app deletion (primary) + email fallback.

Question: Delete data URL
Notes: Same page; deletion removes all associated data at once (no separate partial-delete feature).

Question: Personal info - Name
Notes: Not shared. Purpose: App functionality (account). Not required to keep the app running.

Question: Personal info - Email address
Notes: Not shared. Purpose: App functionality (account).

Question: Financial info - Purchase history
Notes: Not shared. Purpose: App functionality (manage subscription). Payment credentials handled by PhonePe

Question: App activity - App interactions
Notes: Shared with analytics providers. Purpose: Analytics, App functionality.

Question: Device or other IDs - Device or other IDs
Notes: Shared. Purpose: Analytics, Advertising or marketing (advertising ID).

Question: App info and performance - Crash logs
Notes: Not shared. Purpose: App functionality (bug fixing). Anonymised.

Question: App info and performance - Diagnostics
Notes: Not shared. Purpose: App functionality (performance monitoring).

Question: Is data encrypted in transit?
Notes: HTTPS/TLS everywhere.

Question: Can users request data deletion?
Notes: In-app Settings -> Delete account + email fallback.
